acceptance.evidence: severity major (no adjustment). Red at base e76cd3d: the test failed with the verifier's observed value, received 'open-problem.mdx:31: The paper <Cite k="W20"/> states it near its end (page {'57'}, without a number) for any multigraph'. acceptance.item: P6-RT-09-02: The history page states Donnelly and Eriksson's finite-type theorem without the hypothesis that roads run both ways; the one-way board contradicts it
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/content-history-de08-hypothesis.test.ts > the one-way board is connected, not of finite type, and the game from (1,0) ends
acceptance.evidence: severity blocker. Red at base e76cd3d: 1 failed (1), 'history (2008): "... a connected graph with whole-number road counts is a Dynkin diagram of finite type exactly when ...". The one-way board ... ends after 2 moves ...: expected true to be false'. The engine asserts classify kinds ['one-way'] and play {status 'ended', moves 2, end [-1,-1]}, which matches the oracle. acceptance.item: P6-RT-08-08: Attacks 26 and 37: /confusions/ promises a source for every correction, but the section 'Which lattice each game lives in' has none
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/content-confusions-provenance.test.ts > each section carries a citation or a computation
acceptance.evidence: severity minor as filed, raised to major by the reproduce verifier (refute: none); worked as major. Red at base: 'sections of confusions.mdx with no source for their correction: expected [ 'lattices' ] to deeply equal []'. Cause: the section stated SPEC 2.6's definitions and the index det C without provenance. It now says the two readings are definitions (the standard reading in Lie theory, used throughout the site), and that the index is a fact of linear algebra, in the Atlas's wording (an integer matrix with a nonzero determinant sends the integer vectors onto a sublattice whose index is the absolute value of its determinant). No citation was invented. Green: 2 passed. Commit 8d45331. The choice is recorded in the fragment.

The test checks the records and what they claim (lang="en" on every html root, no MutationGraph in site/src or packages/engine/src, the M2 note). Green: the grep prints both headings, 3 passed, and the lens script on a simulated fold exits 0 (D10: 1, D12: 1). Commit 5a190f7.

openQuestions: Not fixed (no finding confirmed it): the section on lattices of /confusions/, SPEC 2.4(c) and the Lie theory paragraphs of M0 and M4 state the index of the populations in the positions as det C for every board. That holds when det C > 0, as on every board of finite type. On an affine board det C = 0 (A1~, C = [[2,-2],[-2,2]]) and the image has infinite index. On the bidirected board with three roads each way det C = 4 - 9 = -5 and the index is 5. The new provenance sentence states the linear-algebra fact with its condition (nonzero determinant, absolute value).
handoff: Every source change is in site/src/content/pages (open-problem, history, confusions). The new tests are in site/tests/unit, and decisions/RT-FIX-P6-pages.md is for MERGE to fold. P6-RT-10-04's location, DECISIONS.md, is MERGE's file, so the records are fragment entries (RT-FIX 5.5) and not the 'dated MERGE lines' of the proposed fix. The D10 note needed no page change: it already stands in a lesson, M2 beat 3, which the D10 entry names and the test reads; the MutationGraph side is the owner's. For P6-RT-08-07 I took the proposed fix's 'node i in both halves' option. For P6-RT-08-08 I used 'definitions' plus 'a fact of linear algebra' and no citation, since none recorded in SOURCES.md states the lattices. When the lens reruns: its RT-09 reproducer cannot pass as written (it requires the old sentence), and its RT-10 script passes once MERGE folds the fragment (checked on a simulated fold).
